content: Technology is not free. Every machine you want to build must first be understood — researched.
Earn research points by engaging with NEXUS technology: mine nexus ore, craft gears, study the machines. Discoveries pay more the first time.
Open the research screen (R), pick a research, and spend your points. Prerequisites are strict: you cannot skip steps.
Completed research unlocks technology permanently. It survives death, travel, and server restarts.
title: How Research Works
